//: Phase 5 (ADR-0009) Lighthouse CI config — WARN-ONLY baseline.
//target: Production target: performance >= 0.9, accessibility >= 0.9, best-practices >= 0.9 (per ADR-0009 §7 Phase 5). Today every assertion is 'warn' so the gate captures a baseline without failing PRs. Flip to 'error' once each page meets the budget.
//auth: The SPA's main pages require an OIDC cookie. Lighthouse runs unauthenticated against `vite preview` (no FastAPI in this workflow), which means most routes will land on the SPA shell + auth-redirect logic. That still measures the shell perf/a11y baseline; full authed runs require an integration job with the FastAPI server which is deferred until the score budgets are taken seriously.
